UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user profile and Spamcaller protection preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in Google user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google account.

email.description: User email address from Google account.

photoUrl.description: Profile photo URL from Google account.

autoBlockEnabled.description: Whether incoming high-risk spam calls are automatically rejected.

spamThreshold.description: Minimum spam risk score (0-100) required to auto-block.

blockHiddenNumbers.description: Whether private/unknown caller ID numbers are blocked.

lastPhoneBackupLabel.description: Human-readable label of the most recent local backup saved on the phone.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on profile creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private Spamcaller profile and call-screening configuration owned by userId.
